given: a stock record filed with a single combined inventory tracking code (encoding location, batch, and serial together)
then: the record includes the combined inventory code exactly as it was filed

independence.rationale: Adds persistence and read-back of the combined inventory_code, which is separate data from the SKU/location/quantity of AC1: the code can be dropped or corrupted while quantity persists correctly, and vice versa.

architectural_notes: API-boundary AC: file with an inventory_code, then GET and assert the code round-trips exactly. Exercised via the branch integration suite. The inventory_code is a persisted column on the Stock model (app/models/stock.py), written and read through app/repositories with app/services orchestrating; the boundary only serializes it. Cross-cutting: field-level validation at the boundary; the code is opaque string data (no domain parsing), so no CHECK constraint beyond NOT NULL is imposed here.
